objective: Allow an AI caller to provide only the business intent while Bateia fills omitted recommendation policy, target and search parameters from a versioned profile.

default_semantics.explicit: preserve the supplied value and validate it, including false, zero, empty string and empty list
default_semantics.license: default a permissive-license allowlist; never assign or infer a candidate license

compatibility: Every previously valid complete recommendation request retains its meaning; only previously missing optional operational fields become accepted.
unknown_policy: Unknown fields and explicit invalid values fail closed. Unknown candidate licenses remain unknown and are never rewritten as permitted.
claim_boundary: This step reduces MCP invocation friction. It does not prove search uplift, add flat-payload inference, or provide legal advice.
